items.title: Can Amphenol Afford Its $4 Billion Buyback?
items.summary: A reader of our Nov 10 look at whether Amphenol stock is really expensive asked for more on the stock. The price has barely moved since. Amphenol (APH) closed at $78.23 on Friday, Nov 13. That is 2.2% below where it stood when that piece ran. So rather than check the price again, this piece takes up the question the Oct 28 results left owners with: can Amphenol pay for everything it just promised.

items.title: Aptiv (APTV) Faces A Fair Value Test On Mixed Third Quarter Results
items.summary: Aptiv (NYSE:APTV) is back in focus after third quarter results that combined solid earnings and new business wins with a more cautious cash flow outlook and fresh warnings about 2027 risks. The third quarter update lands after a rough stretch for Aptiv shareholders, with the share price down 47.3% year to date and the 1-year total shareholder return declining 39.6%. items.summary: Aptiv reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$3.2b and net income of US$194 million, with earnings per share turning positive compared with a loss a year earlier. The company paired this mixed quarter with roughly US$4b of new business awards and a plan to return 100% of free cash flow to shareholders through at least 2027.
